Workers request sections; controller returns ONLY the named response below.

## Independent oracle

- Preserve all Q1–Q4 before data screening, all exact statements and provenance.
- From P1 follow reverse reliance to distinct downstream claims {C1,C2} and
  questions {Q1,Q2}; two paths to Q1 count once. P1/P2 are premises, not additional
  claims. Duplicate C1 deposits and S1/S2/S3 add no independent claim/support.
  Direct claim reach {C1,C2}, direct question reach {}, transitive question reach
  {Q1,Q2}. Seven links L1–L7: six source-stated, one inferred. Source-stated-only
  P1 reach is claims {C1}, questions {Q1}; C2/Q2 depend on inferred L2.
- Keep all 11 proposed links separate from the two stored locator predicates.
  Global link provenance: nine stated, two inferred; none adopted.
- Empty scope maps match, yet contrast and method restrict scope; no unsupported
  author pooling claim. Missing qualifier vocabulary is a scope representation
  gap, not evidence for disease-system states. H-missing/H-invalid are unavailable
  / invalid, and H1's query membership implies no epistemic reliance.
- Quote X1 falsification exactly; it concerns C1. Any link to P1 is a separate
  analyst judgment and not a premise-specific experimental guarantee.
- No automatic reversal; C2 unevaluated remains visible. P1 reach consequences:
  three evaluated endpoints C1/Q1/Q2, one unevaluated C2; all evaluated judgments
  by analyst A. Full inventory: seven evaluated C1/C3/C4/Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4, one
  unevaluated C2. Counts do not turn judgments into source-stated consequences.
- Candidate order may vary. Three defensible choices, all four dispositions,
  nearest alternatives, sensitivity to inferred edges, separate impact/feasibility,
  and Q4 retained despite missing longitudinal assay. No aggregate score,
  expected-information-gain or attractor claim; a catalogue is not holding.
- S1 allowed abstract after matching R-A/group A discovery + prior exposure.
  S2/S3 are aliases; DOI-only resolves A, no independent corroboration.
- S4 conflicting IDs unresolved; no abstract. Its section response does not
  erase the identifier conflict. S5 unknown → isolated data statement → ACC-A
  permits matching A, then allowed abstract; never read abstract to find accession.
- S6 mixed A/B inseparable results: metadata-only; S7 unavailable isolation:
  skip, never whole-body fallback; S10 reserved C: metadata-only.
- S8 isolated references allowed for navigation, review body not read or used
  as scientific evidence. Referenced sources require their own screen.
- S9 confirmed incidental exposure with unknown mapping: record identity, exact
  material, reader/date, known/unknown mapping; stop S9; route to exposure workflow,
  omit from ranking/consequences pending disposition. Other screens continue.
  Uncertain title is separately possible exposure, never falsely resolved.
- Read log identifies actual responses and skipped/unavailable requests. No
  fabricated paper attribution from merely offered sections. No real-world reads.
- Full rehearsal: eight report sections; controller attaches frozen discovery
  bytes and verifies presence/hash before phase B; no claimed attachment without
  actual controller confirmation. Explicit limits of synthetic/source validation.
- Retrieval self-check uses disjoint abstract/body sentinel and isolated sections,
  extracts accessions/reference identities and rejects missing, ambiguous,
  malformed XML without whole-document fallback.
